caption:
Side sleepers know the real problem usually isn't the mattress.

A flat pillow pushes your top shoulder up and twists your neck out of line all night, which is what leaves you stiff in the morning no matter how good the mattress underneath is.

The Eli & Elm Side Sleeper Pillow is built with a U-shaped cutout so your shoulder can settle into the mattress instead of getting crushed against the pillow, keeping your neck and spine aligned.

It's a latex, queen-size pillow made specifically for side sleeping, priced at $114.99 — a lot cheaper than replacing a mattress that was never the issue.
